assessment: This article represents multiple milestones in our understanding of the evolution and extinction of Pleistocene equids, including revising the timing of extinction and clarifying the evolutionary history of Equus (Sussemionus) ovodovi. The discovery of the late persistence of non-caballine equid taxa in Northern China until deep into the late Holocene is particularly important. This finding will be of broad interest to the paleontology, paleoecology, archaeology, and paleogenomic communities and should stimulate important future research into equid extinction processes.
